source_refs.note: Roman Urdu: practice mcqs written from Chapter 3 (PDF 68-89), not printed in the book; same questions and order as the English set. Drafts needing academic review.

blocks.text: Yeh chapter 3 (Algorithms and Problem Solving) ke poore chapter se practice MCQs hain, chapter ke sections ki tarteeb mein. Har sawal ka aik sahi jawab hai aur saath mukhtasar wajah; numerical sawalon mein hal ke qadam diye gaye hain.

blocks.prompt:
1 In this chapter, algorithms are described as:
(Is chapter mein algorithms ko kya kaha gaya hai?)

options.text: kaam karne ki qadam ba qadam hidayaat

blocks.explanation: Algorithms kaam karne ki qadam ba qadam hidayaat hain (3.1).

book_ref.quote: which are step-by-step instructions for performing tasks

blocks.prompt:
2 A computational problem is a challenge that:
(Computational problem kaisa masla hai?)

options.text: algorithm wale computational process se hal ho sakta hai
computer se kabhi hal nahin ho sakta

blocks.explanation: Computational problem woh masla hai jo computational process, yani computer par chalne wale algorithm se hal ho sake.

book_ref.quote: A computational problem is a challenge that can be solved through a computational process

blocks.prompt:
3 In a computational problem, the process is:
(Computational problem mein process kya hai?)

options.text: input par lagaye gaye qadam ya usool jo output banate hain

blocks.explanation: Input diya gaya data, output nateeja, aur process woh qadam/usool jo input par laga kar output banate hain.

book_ref.quote: The steps or rules (algorithm) that are applied to the input to generate the output

blocks.prompt:
4 The objective in solving a computational problem is to find a solution by following:
(Computational problem hal karne ka maqsad kis cheez par chal kar hal dhoondna hai?)

options.text: kabhi khatam na hone wale qadam
computer ke qabil mehdood qadmon ka silsila
aise qadam jo koi computer na kar sake

blocks.explanation: Hal aise mehdood (finite) qadmon se milta hai jo computer kar sake.

book_ref.quote: The objective is to find a solution by following a finite sequence of steps that a computer can perform

blocks.prompt:
5 Characterizing a computational problem involves identifying:
(Computational problem ki khususiyat jaanne mein kya pehchana jata hai?)
blocks.explanation: Masla hal karne ke liye inputs, matloob outputs aur un ko jorne wala process pehchana jata hai.

book_ref.quote: This involves identifying the inputs, the desired outputs, and the process needed to transform the inputs into outputs

blocks.prompt:
6 The problem "Is 97 a prime number?" has the output yes or no. It is a:
(Masla "Kya 97 prime number hai?" ka jawab haan ya na hai. Yeh kis qisam ka masla hai?)
blocks.explanation: Decision problem woh hai jis ka output sirf haan ya na ho.

book_ref.quote: Problems where the output is a simple

blocks.prompt:
7 Finding the student whose roll number is 25 in a class list is a:
(Class list mein roll number 25 wala talib-e-ilm dhoondna kis qisam ka masla hai?)
blocks.explanation: Search problem mein aisi cheez dhoondni hoti hai jo kuch shiraait poori kare.

book_ref.quote: Problems where the task is to find a solution or an item that meets certain criteria

blocks.prompt:
8 Planning the shortest route that visits five colleges is a:
(Paanch colleges se guzarne wala sab se chhota raasta banana kis qisam ka masla hai?)
blocks.explanation: Optimization problem mein kisi miyar par behtareen hal dhoonda jata hai, yahan sab se chhota raasta.

book_ref.quote: Problems where the goal is to find the best solution according to some criteria

blocks.prompt:
9 Finding in how many different ways four books can be arranged on a shelf is a:
(Chaar kitabain shelf par kitne tareeqon se rakhi ja sakti hain, yeh kis qisam ka masla hai?)
blocks.explanation: Counting problem mein ginna hota hai ke kuch shiraait kitne tareeqon se poori ho sakti hain.

book_ref.quote: Problems where the objective is to count the number of ways certain conditions can be met

blocks.prompt:
10 In the well-defined problem of deciding whether a number is even, the process is:
(Number juft (even) hai ya nahin, is well-defined masle mein process kya hai?)

options.text: dekhna ke number 2 se poora taqseem hota hai
number ko khud se zarb dena

blocks.explanation: Maqsad: number juft hai ya nahin; input: aik integer; process: 2 se taqseem ho ga ya nahin; output: even ya odd.

book_ref.quote: clear input (a single integer), a clear process (check if the number is divisible by 2)

blocks.prompt:
11 A project aimed at improving education in Pakistan is an ill-defined problem because:
(Pakistan mein taleem behtar karne ka project ill-defined masla kyon hai?)

options.text: is ka input aik integer hai
yeh 2 se taqseem dekh kar hal hota hai
is ka output saaf haan ya na hai
maqsad mubham aur wasee hai aur zaroriyat wazeh nahin

blocks.explanation: Maqsad mubham aur wasee hai; kitna fund, kaise teachers aur kaun sa material chahiye, yeh wazeh nahin.

book_ref.quote: This goal is vague and broad

blocks.prompt:
12 In the class activity, students plan the shortest route that visits each college exactly once and returns to the start. This is a form of the:
(Class activity mein har college se aik dafa guzar kar wapas aane wala sab se chhota raasta banana kis masle ki shakal hai?)
blocks.explanation: Har jagah aik dafa ja kar sab se chhote raaste se wapas aana Travelling Salesman Problem hai.

book_ref.quote: The goal is to plan the shortest possible route to visit each college exactly once and return to the starting point

blocks.prompt:
13 The chapter compares an algorithm with:
(Chapter algorithm ko kis cheez se milata hai?)
blocks.explanation: Algorithm masla hal karne ke qadam ba qadam tareeqe hain, jaise recipe khana pakane ke qadam deti hai.

book_ref.quote: much like a recipe provides steps for cooking a dish

blocks.prompt:
14 The algorithm used by the Google search engine to judge the relevance of web pages is called:
(Google search engine web pages ki ahmiyat jaanchne ke liye kaun sa algorithm istemal karta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Google PageRank naam ka algorithm web pages ki ahmiyat tay karne ke liye istemal karta hai.

book_ref.quote: The Google search engine uses a complex algorithm called PageRank

blocks.prompt:
15 To rank pages, PageRank considers factors including:
(Pages ki darja bandi ke liye PageRank kin factors ko dekhta hai?)

options.text: page ki taraf links ki tadaad aur un ki quality

blocks.explanation: PageRank page ki taraf links ki tadaad aur un links ki quality dekhta hai.

book_ref.quote: including the number of links to a page and the quality of those links

blocks.prompt:
16 The Generate and Test algorithm works by:
(Generate and Test algorithm kaise kaam karta hai?)

options.text: list ko do hisson mein baantna
hamesha sab se bara sikka chunna
mumkina hal bana kar har aik ko shiraait par parakhna

blocks.explanation: Yeh mumkina hal banata hai aur har aik ko zaroori shiraait par parakhta hai.

book_ref.quote: This algorithm works by generating potential solutions to a problem and then testing each one

blocks.prompt:
17 The Generate and Test process stops when:
(Generate and Test ka amal kab rukta hai?)

options.text: tasalli bakhsh hal mil jaye ya sab hal khatam ho jayen

blocks.explanation: Amal tab tak chalta hai jab tak tasalli bakhsh hal na mil jaye ya sab mumkina hal khatam na ho jayen.

book_ref.quote: The process continues until a satisfactory solution is found or all possible solutions have been exhausted

blocks.prompt:
18 In the Generate step, possible solutions can be produced:
(Generate qadam mein mumkina hal kaise banaye ja sakte hain?)

options.text: sirf user ke type karne se

blocks.explanation: Mumkina hal be-tarteeb (randomly), tarteeb se (systematically) ya kisi heuristic (andaze ke usool) se banaye ja sakte hain.

book_ref.quote: These solutions can be generated randomly, systematically, or based on some heuristic

blocks.prompt:
19 In Generate and Test, if a generated solution does not satisfy all the conditions:
(Generate and Test mein agar bana hua hal sab shiraait poori na kare to:)

options.text: naya hal bana kar amal dohraya jata hai
algorithm phir bhi use maan leta hai
algorithm hamesha ke liye ruk jata hai

blocks.explanation: Jo hal sab shiraait poori kare woh durust hai; warna naya hal bana kar dobara parkha jata hai.

book_ref.quote: If not, the algorithm generates a new solution and repeats the process

blocks.prompt:
20 Generate and Test is particularly useful when:
(Generate and Test khaas tor par kab mufeed hai?)

options.text: problem space itna chhota ho ke sab hal aazmaye ja saken

blocks.explanation: Yeh chhote problem space, wazeh hikmat-e-amli na hone aur heuristics se tadaad kam ho sakne wali suraton mein mufeed hai.

book_ref.quote: The problem space is small, making it feasible to generate and test all possible solutions

blocks.prompt:
21 In Generate and Test, heuristics or rules are applied in order to:
(Generate and Test mein heuristics ya usool kyon lagaye jate hain?)

options.text: banaye jane wale hal ki tadaad kam karna
hal ko ultee tarteeb mein lagana

blocks.explanation: Heuristics banaye jane wale hal ki tadaad kam karte hain, is se amal zyada mo'assar hota hai.

book_ref.quote: Heuristics or rules can be applied to reduce the number of generated solutions

blocks.prompt:
22 The advantage of Generate and Test called exhaustiveness means that it:
(Generate and Test ki khoobi exhaustiveness ka matlab kya hai?)

options.text: sab mumkina hal dekhta hai, koi reh nahin jata

blocks.explanation: Exhaustiveness: yeh sab mumkina hal dekhta hai, is liye koi hal reh nahin jata.

book_ref.quote: The algorithm explores all possible solutions, ensuring that no potential solution is overlooked

blocks.prompt:
23 The drawback "No Optimality Guarantee" of Generate and Test means that it:
(Generate and Test ki kami "No Optimality Guarantee" ka kya matlab hai?)

options.text: sirf sorted list par chalta hai
durust hal ki zamanat, behtareen ki nahin

blocks.explanation: Yeh zaroori nahin ke behtareen hal de; sirf durust (valid) hal ki zamanat hai.

book_ref.quote: it only guarantees a valid one

blocks.prompt:
24 Why can Generate and Test be highly inefficient?
(Generate and Test bohat ghair mo'assar kyon ho sakta hai?)

options.text: yeh koi hal test nahin karta
bare problem space mein bohat se hal parakhne parte hain
yeh sirf graphs par chalta hai

blocks.explanation: Bare problem space mein durust hal milne se pehle bohat se hal parakhne parte hain, is liye yeh mehnga aur sust ho sakta hai.

book_ref.quote: especially for large problem spaces, as it may require testing many possible solutions before finding a valid one

blocks.prompt:
25 The Generate and Test algorithm is often used in AI applications such as:
(Generate and Test algorithm AI ki kin applications mein aksar istemal hota hai?)
blocks.explanation: Yeh AI mein game playing aur problem-solving mein aksar istemal hota hai.

book_ref.quote: The Generate and Test algorithm is often used in AI applications, such as game playing and problem-solving

blocks.prompt:
26 Understanding solvability and complexity helps us determine:
(Solvability aur complexity samajhne se kya pata chalta hai?)

options.text: kaun si programming language nayi hai
masla algorithm se hal hoga ya nahin aur kitni mo'assar tareeqe se

blocks.explanation: Is se pata chalta hai ke masla algorithm se hal ho sakta hai ya nahin, aur kitni mo'assar tareeqe se.

book_ref.quote: It helps us determine whether a problem can be solved using an algorithm and, if so, how efficiently it can be solved

blocks.prompt:
27 A problem is considered solvable if:
(Masla solvable kab kehlata hai?)

options.text: algorithm use mehdood waqt mein hal kar sake

blocks.explanation: Solvable masla woh hai jise algorithm mehdood waqt mein hal kar sake.

book_ref.quote: A problem is considered solvable if an algorithm can solve it within a finite amount of time

blocks.prompt:
28 The chapter's example of a solvable problem is:
(Chapter mein solvable masle ki misaal kya hai?)

options.text: Euclidean algorithm se do integers ka GCD
20 cities ka TSP jaldi aur theek hal karna

blocks.explanation: Do integers ka GCD nikalna solvable hai; Euclidean algorithm is ka wazeh aur mehdood tareeqa hai.

book_ref.quote: The Euclidean algorithm provides a clear and finite method to determine the GCD

blocks.prompt:
29 The Halting Problem asks:
(Halting Problem kya poochhta hai?)

options.text: diya gaya program aakhir rukega ya hamesha chalega
do numbers ka GCD kaise nikalein

blocks.explanation: Halting Problem yeh tay karna hai ke diya gaya program aakhir ruk jayega ya hamesha chalta rahega.

book_ref.quote: It involves determining whether a given program will eventually halt (finish running) or continue to run forever

blocks.prompt:
30 Who proved that no general algorithm can solve the Halting Problem for all program-input pairs?
(Kis ne sabit kiya ke koi aam algorithm Halting Problem ko har program-input jore ke liye hal nahin kar sakta?)
blocks.explanation: Alan Turing ne sabit kiya ke Halting Problem ka koi aam algorithm nahin.

book_ref.quote: Alan Turing proved that no general algorithm can solve the Halting Problem for all possible program-input pairs

blocks.prompt:
31 When tackling a complex problem, why should you first find out whether it is solvable?
(Mushkil masle par kaam se pehle yeh kyon dekhna chahiye ke woh solvable hai?)
blocks.explanation: Pehle solvability dekhne se waqt aur wasail bachte hain.

book_ref.quote: This saves time and resources by ensuring you are working on a problem that can be resolved using an algorithm

blocks.prompt:
32 Problems are categorized as tractable or intractable on the basis of:
(Masail ko tractable ya intractable kis bunyad par kaha jata hai?)

options.text: hal ke liye darkaar wasail (waqt aur jagah)

blocks.explanation: Tractable aur intractable ka faisla hal ke liye darkaar waqt aur jagah (memory) par hota hai.

book_ref.quote: Problems are categorized as tractable or intractable based on the resources required (time and space) to solve them

blocks.prompt:
33 A problem is called tractable if it can be solved in:
(Masla tractable kab kehlata hai?)
blocks.explanation: Tractable masla polynomial time (P) mein hal hota hai; waqt input ke sath qabil-e-intezam raftaar se barhta hai.

book_ref.quote: A problem is considered tractable if it can be solved in polynomial time, denoted as P

blocks.prompt:
34 Intractable problems are impractical for large inputs because they:
(Intractable masail bare inputs ke liye na-qabil-e-amal kyon hain?)
blocks.explanation: Intractable masail ko super-polynomial (aksar exponential) waqt chahiye, is liye bare inputs par waqt qaboo se bahar ho jata hai.

book_ref.quote: Intractable problems are those that require super-polynomial time to solve, often growing exponentially with the size of the input

blocks.prompt:
35 Using the chapter's factorial count of routes, how many possible routes are there for 6 cities?
(Chapter ke factorial wale hisab se 6 cities ke kitne mumkina raaste hain?)

book_ref.quote: Factorially means, multiplying all whole numbers from n down to 1

blocks.prompt:
36 Sorting a list of numbers with Merge Sort or Quick Sort is an example of:
(Merge Sort ya Quick Sort se numbers sort karna kis ki misaal hai?)
blocks.explanation: Merge Sort ya Quick Sort se sorting polynomial time mein hoti hai, is liye tractable hai.

book_ref.quote: Sorting a list of numbers using algorithms like Merge Sort or Quick Sort is a tractable problem

blocks.prompt:
37 Complexity classes group problems according to:
(Complexity classes masail ko kis bunyad par groups mein baantti hain?)

options.text: solvability aur hal ka darkaar waqt

blocks.explanation: Masail solvability aur hal ke liye darkaar waqt ki bunyad par baante jate hain.

book_ref.quote: classifying them into different categories based on their solvability and the time required to solve them

blocks.prompt:
38 In the chapter's Class P sorting example, doubling the size of the list makes the time needed:
(Chapter ki Class P sorting misaal mein list dugni karne se waqt kitna hota hai?)
blocks.explanation: Polynomial time andaze ke mutabiq barhta hai: list dugni to waqt taqreeban dugna.

book_ref.quote: Doubling the size of the list results in roughly double the time needed

blocks.prompt:
39 Sorting is called a deterministic algorithm in the chapter because:
(Chapter mein sorting ko deterministic algorithm kyon kaha gaya?)

options.text: is ke wazeh qadam hamesha durust nateeja dete hain
yeh jawab ka andaza lagati hai
yeh sirf Sudoku par chalti hai

blocks.explanation: Sorting wazeh qadmon (compare aur swap) par chalti hai jo hamesha durust nateeja dete hain.

book_ref.quote: Following these steps always leads to the correct result if done correctly

blocks.prompt:
40 For the list [4, 1, 3, 2, 5], after the first step (compare the first two numbers and swap if needed) the list becomes:
(List [4, 1, 3, 2, 5] mein pehla qadam (pehle do numbers compare kar ke zaroorat ho to swap) ke baad list kya hogi?)
blocks.explanation: 4 > 1, is liye swap: [1, 4, 3, 2, 5]; phir agla jora.

book_ref.quote: Compare the first number with the second number. Swap them if needed.

blocks.prompt:
41 Class NP refers to problems for which:
(Class NP kin masail ko kehte hain?)

options.text: koi hal kabhi jaancha na ja sake
diya gaya hal jaldi jaancha ja sake, magar dhoondna mushkil ho

blocks.explanation: NP mein diya gaya hal jaldi jaancha ja sakta hai, magar hal dhoondna mushkil aur waqt talab ho sakta hai.

book_ref.quote: if a solution is given, it can be checked quickly by a computer

blocks.prompt:
42 In Sudoku, each row, column and 3 x 3 sub-grid of the 9 x 9 grid must contain:
(Sudoku mein 9 x 9 grid ki har row, column aur 3 x 3 sub-grid mein kya hona chahiye?)

options.text: 1 se 9 tak har hindsa theek aik dafa

blocks.explanation: Har row, column aur 3 x 3 sub-grid mein 1 se 9 tak har hindsa theek aik dafa.

book_ref.quote: you fill a 9 x 9 grid with numbers so that each row, column, and 3 x 3 sub grid contains all digits from 1 to 9 exactly once

blocks.prompt:
43 Sudoku is placed in Class NP because:
(Sudoku Class NP mein kyon hai?)

options.text: yeh foran hal ho jata hai
mukammal grid jaanchna aasan, shuru se hal karna mushkil
ise kabhi jaancha nahin ja sakta

blocks.explanation: Mukammal grid jaldi jaanchi ja sakti hai, magar shuru se hal karne ka koi aasan tez tareeqa nahin.

book_ref.quote: There is no simple, fast way to guarantee a solution

blocks.prompt:
44 NP-hard problems are problems that are:
(NP-hard masail kaise hote hain?)

options.text: NP ke sab se mushkil masail jitne mushkil
P ke har masle se aasan

blocks.explanation: NP-hard masail NP ke sab se mushkil masail jitne ya un se zyada mushkil hain; koi mo'assar algorithm maloom nahin.

book_ref.quote: are at least as difficult as the hardest problems in NP

blocks.prompt:
45 According to the chapter, how many possible routes are there in TSP with 10 cities?
(Chapter ke mutabiq 10 cities ke TSP mein kitne mumkina raaste hain?)
blocks.explanation: 10 cities par 10! = 3,628,800 raaste; is liye TSP itna mushkil hai.

book_ref.quote: For example, with just 10 cities, there are 3,628,800 possible routes

blocks.prompt:
46 TSP is a well-known example of a problem that is:
(TSP kis qisam ke masle ki mashhoor misaal hai?)
blocks.explanation: TSP NP-hard hai: koi tez algorithm maloom nahin aur raaste factorial raftaar se barhte hain.

book_ref.quote: The time required to solve TSP grows so quickly with the number of cities

blocks.prompt:
47 Which statement about NP-Complete problems is correct?
(NP-Complete masail ke bare mein kaun sa bayan durust hai?)

options.text: aik NP-Complete ka tez hal sab NP masail ko tez hal kar dega
yeh sab Class P se aasan hain
inhein kabhi jaancha nahin ja sakta

blocks.explanation: NP-Complete masail NP mein bhi hain aur NP ke sab se mushkil jitne bhi; aik ka tez hal sab NP ka tez hal hoga.

book_ref.quote: if you can solve one NP-Complete problem efficiently, you can solve all problems in NP efficiently

blocks.prompt:
48 The goal of the Knapsack Problem is to:
(Knapsack Problem ka maqsad kya hai?)

options.text: har city se aik dafa guzar kar wapas aana
wazan ki had ke andar sab se qeemti cheezein chunna
program rukega ya nahin tay karna

blocks.explanation: Knapsack: wazan ki had paar kiye baghair sab se qeemti cheezon ka majmooa chunna.

book_ref.quote: The goal is to determine the most valuable combination of items to put in the knapsack without exceeding its weight capacity

blocks.prompt:
49 Brute force becomes impractical for large Knapsack instances because the number of possible combinations:
(Bare Knapsack masail mein brute force na-qabil-e-amal kyon hai?)

options.text: cheezein barhne par exponential barhti hai

blocks.explanation: Cheezein barhne par combinations exponential raftaar se barhte hain, sab jaanchna mumkin nahin rehta.

book_ref.quote: As the number of items grows, the number of possible combinations increases exponentially

blocks.prompt:
50 In Figure 3.4, the relationships between P, NP, NP-hard and NP-complete are shown with a:
(Figure 3.4 mein P, NP, NP-hard aur NP-complete ka talluq kis se dikhaya gaya hai?)
blocks.explanation: Figure 3.4 complexity classes ka Venn diagram hai.

book_ref.quote: Figure 3.4 shows a Venn diagram of the complexity classes P, NP, NP-hard, and NP-complete

blocks.prompt:
51 Which of these is described as one of the most important unsolved problems in computer science?
(Computer science ke sab se aham hal na hue masail mein se kaun sa bataya gaya hai?)

options.text: sorted list mein search kaise karein
kya P aur NP barabar hain

blocks.explanation: P aur NP barabar hain ya nahin, yeh bara hal na hua sawal hai jis ka asar cryptography aur algorithm design par hai.

book_ref.quote: The question of whether P equals NP is one of the most important unsolved problems in computer science

blocks.prompt:
52 Algorithm analysis is the process of determining an algorithm's:
(Algorithm analysis kis cheez ka andaza lagane ka amal hai?)
blocks.explanation: Algorithm analysis algorithms ki time aur space complexity tay karta hai taa ke behtareen chuna ja sake.

book_ref.quote: Algorithm analysis is the process of determining the computational complexity of algorithms

blocks.prompt:
53 In the chapter's sorting example of time complexity, as the volume of numbers increases, the time required to sort them:
(Chapter ki sorting misaal mein numbers ki miqdar barhne par sort ka waqt:)
blocks.explanation: Thore numbers jaldi sort hote hain; miqdar barhne par waqt barhta hai, aur time complexity is barhotri ka andaza deti hai.

book_ref.quote: as the volume of numbers increases, the time required to sort them also increases

blocks.prompt:
54 Big O notation gives:
(Big O notation kya batati hai?)

options.text: har computer par seconds mein theek waqt
input barhne par waqt ki upari had

blocks.explanation: Big O input barhne par algorithm ke waqt ki upari had batati hai, is se algorithms ka muqabla hota hai.

book_ref.quote: It provides an upper bound on the time an algorithm will take to complete as the input size grows

blocks.prompt:
55 Accessing a specific item of an array by its index has the time complexity:
(Array mein index se khaas item tak pohanchne ki time complexity kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: Array chhota ho ya bara, waqt aik jaisa; is liye O(1).

book_ref.quote: accessing a specific item in an array by its index is constant time

blocks.prompt:
56 Finding a student by checking the IDs of n students one by one has the time complexity:
(n talaba ki IDs aik aik kar ke dekh kar talib-e-ilm dhoondne ki time complexity kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: Bad tareen surat mein sab n talaba dekhne parte hain, is liye O(n).

book_ref.quote: In the worst-case scenario, the student we are looking for might be the very last one on the list

blocks.prompt:
57 To compare each of 10 students with every other student once, the number of comparisons is:
(10 talaba mein har aik ko baqi har aik se aik dafa compare karne ke liye kitne comparisons honge?)
blocks.explanation: Jore n(n − 1)/2 = 10 × 9/2 = 45 (kitab ki durusti); complexity O(n²).

book_ref.quote: we must compare each student with every other student

blocks.prompt:
58 In the guessing game where the range 1 to n is halved after each guess, the time complexity is:
(Andaza lagane ke khel mein jahan har andaze ke baad range aadhi hoti hai, time complexity kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: Andazon ki tadaad range ko aadha karne ki tadaad ke barabar hai, yani O(log n).

book_ref.quote: The number of guesses required to find the correct number is proportional to the number of times you can halve the range

blocks.prompt:
59 On the Big O growth graph, constant time O(1) appears as:
(Big O graph par constant time O(1) kaisa nazar aata hai?)
blocks.explanation: O(1) n se nahin badalta, is liye graph par seedhi sapaat (flat) line hai.

book_ref.quote: Constant time, represented as O(1), remains unchanged regardless of the size of n

blocks.prompt:
60 Space complexity measures how an algorithm's use of ______ changes as the input grows.
(Space complexity naapti hai ke input barhne par algorithm ka kis cheez ka istemal kaise badalta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Space complexity naapti hai ke input barhne par memory ka istemal kaise badalta hai.

book_ref.quote: Space complexity measures how the amount of memory or space an algorithm uses changes as the size of the input data increases

blocks.prompt:
61 An algorithm that stores an n × n matrix has the space complexity:
(n × n matrix mehfooz karne wale algorithm ki space complexity kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: n × n matrix mein n² elements hain, is liye O(n²).

book_ref.quote: an algorithm that needs to store a matrix of size n x n will have quadratic space complexity

blocks.prompt:
62 An algorithm that needs only a few variables, whatever the input size, has:
(Jo algorithm input jitna bhi ho sirf chand variables istemal kare, us ki space complexity kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: Input se be-niaz mehdood memory constant space O(1) hai.

book_ref.quote: a simple algorithm that only needs a few variables to store intermediate values has constant space complexity

blocks.prompt:
63 Space complexity matters especially for:
(Space complexity khaas tor par kahan aham hai?)

options.text: bari applications ya kam memory wale systems

blocks.explanation: Bari applications aur kam memory wale systems mein memory ka mo'assar istemal zaroori hai.

book_ref.quote: Efficient use of memory is crucial, especially for large-scale applications or systems with limited memory resources

blocks.prompt:
